headline: Spandana Sphoorty posts Rs 18 crore profit in Q2
hook: Turning the corner after heavy losses
summary: Spandana Sphoorty Financial reported a consolidated Q2 profit of Rs 18 crore, reversing a Rs 249 crore loss from the same period last year. Assets under management grew 31% to reach Rs 5,364 crore during the quarter. Asset quality also improved, leading to a reduction in both gross and net non-performing assets. This turnaround reflects operational recovery for the microfinance lender, affecting portfolio valuation and investor sentiment.
why_it_matters: Return to profitability boosts lender valuation and investor sentiment.
winners_losers: Spandana Sphoorty gains / previous loss-makers hurt
